name: Plain text
guidance: Best in a monospace editor. The receiving app may collapse spaces or wrap long rows.

name: Instagram DMs
guidance: Start narrow. Proportional fonts, line wrapping, and repeated spaces may change the silhouette.

name: Facebook
guidance: Feed and comment layouts vary. Test a small part first; monospace and preserved spacing are not assumed.

name: WhatsApp
guidance: Try blocks or Braille, then check the recipient's font. This profile sends plain text without formatting assumptions.

name: Discord
guidance: Optional fenced code blocks are documented by Discord. The budget is an adjustable conservative estimate; account and client behavior varies.

name: X DMs
guidance: Use narrow rows. Fonts, whitespace, and accepted lengths may vary by account and client.

name: Messenger
guidance: A compact Unicode variant may help with silhouettes. Glyph shape and spacing vary across devices.
